subject: Scaling up data throughput
text:
Hi [NAME],

Congrats on your recent funding. It's exciting to see your team continuing
to grow!

At Encord, we partner with defense and space teams to enhance training data
quality and scale annotation pipelines, so teams can dedicate more time to
improving model performance and accelerating deployment. As a data-layer
scale-up, we support 200+ AI teams across industries, with particular
experience in physical AI and robotics applications.

It looks like there could be an opportunity to help speed up your data
workflows as you scale. Would you be open to a quick chat next week? Would
Monday work for you?

subject: Coffee in Austin - LPR accuracy
text:
Hi [NAME],

I wanted to reach out since I saw Flash recently updated the camera spec  -
how you're thinking about improving vision model accuracy with the new data
inputs?

You might find our learnings with other AI-powered camera teams
(Metropolis, Flock Safety, Milestone Systems) interesting. We focus on
helping them utilize as much camera data as possible - more efficient
curation method and annotation quality.

We'd love to exchange perspectives on building more accurate vision models.
Our leadership team will be in Austin Wed (10/19) to Thurs (10/20) - would
you be open to a coffee?

subject: Coffee in Austin - annotation efficiency
text:
Hi [NAME],

I was in touch with Vib early this year - sounds like improving annotation
quality with a lean team was how he was thinking about data operations.
Given your role leading the engineering projects at Saronic - I'd love to
hear your perspectives on this.

We're familiar with the challenges of ensuring label quality across camera,
LiDAR and radar data. We recently helped Zipline consolidate 2D and 3D
annotation pipelines in one place with better autolabelling capabilities.
Happy to also share how we work with ML teams in defense environments like
Maxar.

It'd be great to chat over a coffee. We'll be in Austin Wed (10/19) to
Thurs (10/20) next week - happy to swing by your office or meet at a coffee
shop somewhere nearby?
